cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

project(sqlitebrowser_sqlcipher
    VERSION 4.18.0
    DESCRIPTION "SQLiteBrowser SQLCipher Windows x64 shared dependency"
    LANGUAGES C RC
)

if(NOT WIN32)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "This SQLCipher wrapper only supports Windows.")
endif()

if(NOT MSVC)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "This SQLCipher wrapper requires Visual Studio 2022.")
endif()

if(MSVC_VERSION LESS 1930 OR MSVC_VERSION GREATER_EQUAL 1950)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "Unsupported MSVC version ${MSVC_VERSION}. Visual Studio 2022 is required."
    )
endif()

if(NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "This SQLCipher wrapper only supports x64 builds.")
endif()

set(SQLCIPHER_CONFIGURATION "" CACHE STRING
    "Single configuration generated by this wrapper (Debug or Release)"
)
set_property(CACHE SQLCIPHER_CONFIGURATION PROPERTY STRINGS Debug Release)
if(NOT SQLCIPHER_CONFIGURATION MATCHES "^(Debug|Release)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "SQLCIPHER_CONFIGURATION must be Debug or Release. "
        "Use a configuration-specific build directory."
    )
endif()

# Each work directory represents one configuration. This prevents a Release
# target from reusing Debug-specific generated sources (or the reverse).
set(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES "${SQLCIPHER_CONFIGURATION}" CACHE STRING
    "Supported SQLCipher configuration" FORCE
)

set(SQLCIPHER_WINDOWS_SDK_VERSION "10.0.26100.0" CACHE STRING
    "Required Windows SDK version"
)
if(DEFINED CMAKE_VS_WINDOWS_TARGET_PLATFORM_VERSION
        AND NOT CMAKE_VS_WINDOWS_TARGET_PLATFORM_VERSION STREQUAL ""
        AND NOT CMAKE_VS_WINDOWS_TARGET_PLATFORM_VERSION STREQUAL SQLCIPHER_WINDOWS_SDK_VERSION)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "Windows SDK ${SQLCIPHER_WINDOWS_SDK_VERSION} is required, but CMake selected "
        "${CMAKE_VS_WINDOWS_TARGET_PLATFORM_VERSION}."
    )
endif()

set(SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src")
set(SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT "" CACHE PATH
    "Matching configuration's repository OpenSSL stage"
)
set(SQLCIPHER_EXTRA_DEFINITIONS "" CACHE STRING
    "Additional audited definitions (semicolon-separated, without -D)"
)

if(NOT EXISTS "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/Makefile.msc"
        OR NOT EXISTS "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/src/sqlcipher.c"
        OR NOT EXISTS "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/src/sqlite3.rc")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "The SQLCipher submodule is incomplete. Run: git submodule update --init --recursive"
    )
endif()

set(_openssl_required_files
    "${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}/include/openssl/opensslv.h"
    "${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}/lib/libcrypto.lib"
    "${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}/bin/libcrypto-3-x64.dll"
    "${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}/bin/brotlicommon.dll"
    "${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}/bin/brotlidec.dll"
    "${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}/bin/brotlienc.dll"
    "${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}/build-manifest.txt"
)
foreach(_file IN LISTS _openssl_required_files)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${_file}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "Required ${SQLCIPHER_CONFIGURATION} OpenSSL stage artifact is missing: ${_file}"
        )
    endif()
endforeach()

foreach(_path IN ITEMS
        "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
        "${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}")
    if(_path MATCHES "[ \t]")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "SQLCipher's upstream Makefile.msc source-generation step does not support "
            "paths containing spaces: ${_path}"
        )
    endif()
endforeach()

find_program(SQLCIPHER_NMAKE_EXECUTABLE NAMES nmake.exe nmake REQUIRED)

set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY
    "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>DLL"
    CACHE STRING "Use /MDd for Debug and /MD for Release" FORCE
)

# Keep this list authoritative for both source generation and product
# compilation. It preserves the current Makefile.msc feature baseline while
# making every project-owned choice visible in CMake and the manifest.
set(_sqlcipher_definitions
    SQLITE_HAS_CODEC=1
    SQLITE_TEMP_STORE=2
    SQLITE_EXTRA_INIT=sqlcipher_extra_init
    SQLITE_EXTRA_SHUTDOWN=sqlcipher_extra_shutdown
    SQLCIPHER_CRYPTO_OPENSSL=1
    SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1
    SQLITE_THREAD_OVERRIDE_LOCK=-1
    SQLITE_MAX_TRIGGER_DEPTH=100
    SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS3=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS3_PARENTHESIS=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_STAT4=1
    SQLITE_SOUNDEX=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_JSON1=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_GEOPOLY=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_RTREE=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_MATH_FUNCTIONS=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_PERCENTILE=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_STMTVTAB=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_DBPAGE_VTAB=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_DBSTAT_VTAB=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_BYTECODE_VTAB=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_CARRAY=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA=1
    SQLITE_MAX_ATTACHED=125
    ${SQLCIPHER_EXTRA_DEFINITIONS}
)

foreach(_definition IN LISTS _sqlcipher_definitions)
    if(_definition MATCHES "^-D" OR _definition MATCHES "[&|<>^]")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "Invalid SQLCipher definition '${_definition}'. "
            "Use semicolon-separated NAME or NAME=VALUE entries without -D."
        )
    endif()
endforeach()

set(_nmake_definitions "")
foreach(_definition IN LISTS _sqlcipher_definitions)
    string(APPEND _nmake_definitions " -D${_definition}")
endforeach()
string(STRIP "${_nmake_definitions}" _nmake_definitions)
list(JOIN _sqlcipher_definitions ";" _definitions_manifest)

if(SQLCIPHER_CONFIGURATION STREQUAL "Debug")
    set(_nmake_debug_level 3)
    set(_nmake_generator_ldflags "/DEBUG")
    set(_configuration_crt "/MDd")
else()
    set(_nmake_debug_level 0)
    set(_nmake_generator_ldflags "")
    set(_configuration_crt "/MD")
endif()

file(READ "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/VERSION" _sqlite_version)
string(STRIP "${_sqlite_version}" _sqlite_version)
string(REPLACE "." "," _sqlite_resource_version "${_sqlite_version}")

set(_generated_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
set(_generated_sqlite3_c "${_generated_dir}/sqlite3.c")
set(_generated_sqlite3_h "${_generated_dir}/sqlite3.h")
set(_generated_sqlite3ext_h "${_generated_dir}/sqlite3ext.h")
set(_generated_sqlite3session_h "${_generated_dir}/sqlite3session.h")
set(_generated_shell_c "${_generated_dir}/shell.c")
set(_sqlite_resource_header "${_generated_dir}/sqlite3rc.h")
set(_sqlite_resource_header_template
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/sqlite3rc.generated.h"
)
set(_generated_outputs
    "${_generated_sqlite3_c}"
    "${_generated_sqlite3_h}"
    "${_generated_sqlite3ext_h}"
    "${_generated_sqlite3session_h}"
    "${_generated_shell_c}"
    "${_sqlite_resource_header}"
)

file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_generated_dir}")
file(WRITE "${_sqlite_resource_header_template}"
    "#ifndef SQLITE_RESOURCE_VERSION\n"
    "#define SQLITE_RESOURCE_VERSION ${_sqlite_resource_version}\n"
    "#endif\n"
)
file(TO_NATIVE_PATH "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}" _source_native)
file(TO_NATIVE_PATH "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/Makefile.msc" _makefile_native)

set(_nmake_common_arguments
    /nologo
    /f "${_makefile_native}"
    "TOP=${_source_native}"
    PLATFORM=x64
    USE_AMALGAMATION=1
    USE_CRT_DLL=1
    NO_TCL=1
    DYNAMIC_SHELL=1
    USE_RC=0
    "DEBUG=${_nmake_debug_level}"
    "LDFLAGS=${_nmake_generator_ldflags}"
    "OPTS=${_nmake_definitions}"
)

# The pinned SQLCipher tag does not contain generated amalgamation files.
# Retain the upstream generator, but stop at source generation. CMake/MSBuild
# owns DLL/CLI compilation, linking, testing, installation, and PDB policy.
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${_generated_outputs}
    COMMAND "${SQLCIPHER_NMAKE_EXECUTABLE}"
        ${_nmake_common_arguments}
        clean
    COMMAND "${SQLCIPHER_NMAKE_EXECUTABLE}"
        ${_nmake_common_arguments}
        sqlite3.c sqlite3.h sqlite3ext.h sqlite3session.h shell.c
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different
        "${_sqlite_resource_header_template}"
        "${_sqlite_resource_header}"
    DEPENDS
        "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/Makefile.msc"
        "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/VERSION"
        "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/manifest"
        "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/manifest.uuid"
        "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/src/sqlcipher.c"
        "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/src/crypto_openssl.c"
        "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/src/sqlite.h.in"
        "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/src/shell.c.in"
        "${_sqlite_resource_header_template}"
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${_generated_dir}"
    COMMENT "Generating SQLCipher ${PROJECT_VERSION} sources with Makefile.msc"
    USES_TERMINAL
    VERBATIM
)

add_custom_target(sqlcipher_generate DEPENDS ${_generated_outputs})
set_source_files_properties(${_generated_outputs} PROPERTIES GENERATED TRUE)

set(_sqlite_resource "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/src/sqlite3.rc")
set_source_files_properties("${_sqlite_resource}" PROPERTIES
    OBJECT_DEPENDS "${_generated_sqlite3_h};${_sqlite_resource_header}"
    INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${_generated_dir}"
)

add_library(OpenSSL::Crypto SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(OpenSSL::Crypto PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_IMPLIB "${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}/lib/libcrypto.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}/bin/libcrypto-3-x64.dll"
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}/include"
)

set(_common_private_definitions
    ${_sqlcipher_definitions}
    SQLITE_OS_WIN=1
    _CRT_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE
    _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
    _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_DEPRECATE
    _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_WARNINGS
    "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:SQLITE_ENABLE_API_ARMOR=1>"
    "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:SQLITE_DEBUG=1>"
    "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:SQLITE_USE_W32_FOR_CONSOLE_IO>"
)
set(_common_compile_options
    /fp:precise
    /wd4054 /wd4055 /wd4100 /wd4127 /wd4130 /wd4152 /wd4189 /wd4206
    /wd4210 /wd4232 /wd4244 /wd4305 /wd4306 /wd4702 /wd4706
    "$<$<CONFIG:Release>:/Zi>"
)
set(_release_link_options
    "$<$<CONFIG:Release>:/DEBUG:FULL>"
    "$<$<CONFIG:Release>:/OPT:REF>"
    "$<$<CONFIG:Release>:/OPT:ICF>"
)

add_library(sqlcipher SHARED
    "${_generated_sqlite3_c}"
    "${_sqlite_resource}"
)
add_dependencies(sqlcipher sqlcipher_generate)
add_library(SQLCipher::SQLCipher ALIAS sqlcipher)
target_compile_definitions(sqlcipher
    PRIVATE ${_common_private_definitions}
    INTERFACE SQLITE_HAS_CODEC=1 SQLITE_TEMP_STORE=2
)
target_include_directories(sqlcipher
    PUBLIC
        "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${_generated_dir}>"
        "$<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include/sqlcipher>"
)
target_link_libraries(sqlcipher PRIVATE OpenSSL::Crypto)
target_compile_options(sqlcipher PRIVATE ${_common_compile_options})
target_link_options(sqlcipher PRIVATE ${_release_link_options})
set_target_properties(sqlcipher PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME sqlcipher
    DEBUG_POSTFIX ""
    WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON
    C_STANDARD 99
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES
    C_EXTENSIONS NO
)

add_executable(sqlcipher_cli EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
    "${_generated_shell_c}"
    "${_sqlite_resource}"
)
add_dependencies(sqlcipher_cli sqlcipher_generate)
target_compile_definitions(sqlcipher_cli PRIVATE
    ${_common_private_definitions}
    HAVE_READLINE=0
)
target_include_directories(sqlcipher_cli PRIVATE "${_generated_dir}")
target_link_libraries(sqlcipher_cli PRIVATE sqlcipher)
target_compile_options(sqlcipher_cli PRIVATE ${_common_compile_options})
target_link_options(sqlcipher_cli PRIVATE ${_release_link_options})
set_target_properties(sqlcipher_cli PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME sqlcipher
    PDB_NAME sqlcipher-cli
    DEBUG_POSTFIX ""
    C_STANDARD 99
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES
    C_EXTENSIONS NO
)

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME sqlcipher.provider.smoke
    COMMAND "$<TARGET_FILE:sqlcipher_cli>" :memory:
        "PRAGMA key='provider-probe'; PRAGMA cipher_version; PRAGMA cipher_provider; PRAGMA cipher_provider_version;"
)
set_tests_properties(sqlcipher.provider.smoke PROPERTIES
    LABELS "smoke;shared;provider"
    PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION
        "4\\.18\\.0 community(.|\n)*openssl(.|\n)*OpenSSL 3\\.5\\.7"
    ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION
        "PATH=path_list_prepend:$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:sqlcipher>;PATH=path_list_prepend:${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}/bin"
)

include(GNUInstallDirs)
install(TARGETS sqlcipher
    RUNTIME DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}"
        COMPONENT SQLCipherProduct
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}"
        COMPONENT SQLCipherProduct
    INCLUDES DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/sqlcipher"
)
install(FILES
    "${_generated_sqlite3_h}"
    "${_generated_sqlite3ext_h}"
    "${_generated_sqlite3session_h}"
    DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/sqlcipher"
    COMPONENT SQLCipherProduct
)
install(FILES
    "$<TARGET_PDB_FILE:sqlcipher>"
    DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}"
    CONFIGURATIONS Debug Release
    COMPONENT SQLCipherProduct
)
install(FILES
    "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/LICENSE.md"
    "${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}/SQLITE_LICENSE.md"
    DESTINATION "share/licenses/sqlcipher"
    COMPONENT SQLCipherProduct
)

set(_settings_file "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/sqlcipher-build-settings.txt")
file(WRITE "${_settings_file}"
    "Build system: CMake/MSBuild (Makefile.msc source generation only)\n"
    "Source generation: sqlite3.c;sqlite3.h;sqlite3ext.h;sqlite3session.h;shell.c\n"
    "SQLite baseline: ${_sqlite_version}\n"
    "Configuration: ${SQLCIPHER_CONFIGURATION}\n"
    "CRT: ${_configuration_crt}\n"
    "Definitions: ${_definitions_manifest}\n"
)

message(STATUS "SQLCipher source: ${SQLCIPHER_SOURCE_DIR}")
message(STATUS "SQLCipher configuration: ${SQLCIPHER_CONFIGURATION}")
message(STATUS "SQLCipher source generator: Makefile.msc via ${SQLCIPHER_NMAKE_EXECUTABLE}")
message(STATUS "SQLCipher product compiler: CMake/MSBuild")
message(STATUS "SQLCipher OpenSSL stage: ${SQLCIPHER_OPENSSL_ROOT}")
message(STATUS "SQLCipher Windows SDK: ${SQLCIPHER_WINDOWS_SDK_VERSION}")
